design.decision: Sequence your winners together: cash a run of honors before handing back the lead.
design.opponent: Shown when the run is reached. Opponents may duck to break runs.
design.rationale: This is the common rung of the streak ladder below seed-four-row (uncommon). A deliberate near-duplicate on threshold: three in a row fires often enough for a common.
design.draftText: +8 contract multiplier when your team wins three tricks in a row

critic.concerns: Threshold near-duplicate of seed-four-row and cb-five-row-mult.
